description: The pie charts represent the distribution of problem categories labeled as 'easy,' 'medium,' and 'hard' under Zero-Shot settings, with each chart containing four segments. In the 'easy' category, the largest segment is 'N+K+' in teal, accounting for approximately 55.4%, followed by 'N−K+' in yellow at 38.3%. The 'medium' category shows a similar trend, with 'N+K+' comprising 58.8% and 'N−K+' at 35.4%. In the 'hard' category, 'N−K−' in orange is the largest segment at 47.9%, followed by 'N−K+' in yellow at 37.3%. Notably, the proportion of 'N+K−' in red remains consistent across all categories, stabilizing at around 1.7% for 'easy' and 'medium,' and increasing slightly to 6.7% for 'hard.' These charts highlight a decline in 'N+K+' as difficulty increases, while 'N−K−' exhibits a sharp rise in the 'hard' category.
